notes.title: 🌟The v0.5 Update is finally here!🌟
notes.notes:
[p]This update has been a long time in the works, art takes a long time, but we finally present big updates to the Visual Effect and Sound Effects in combat, AND all Astrals are now fully animated! No more placeholder Astrals!
This marks a major milestone in visual and audio polish—every combat action now feels more impactful and dynamic.
There's a new Rank system, difficulty options, tutorial, and the demo actually has an end now :O
We've also added the ability to manually override the Engage & Disengage, giving you more control of positioning and timing! This adds greater tactical depth and flexibility in combat.[/p][p]This and more ![/p][p]Try the updated demo today and let us know what you think [url="https://thegamegarden.itch.io/astral-arena-demo" style="button"]download for Free[/url] !![/p][p]Change Log -[/p][p][b]🆕 New Features and Additions[/b][/p][p]🆕 Manual override for Engage/Disengage mechanics, tell your Astrals to get close or stay back, manually dodge or apply pressure up close![/p][p]🆕 New Rank System: Progression now feels more rewarding and meaningful. Start as a lowly Unranked, climb the ladder to the Champion seat, unlocking more and more combat features as you go! 
🆕 New VFX & SFX: ALL Skills have hand crafted visual FX and Sound FX! Really brings combat to life!
🆕 New Astrals! : We now have a complete [b]first set[/b] of Astrals, 13 species with 3 type variants each, thats [b]39 units to master[/b], as well as [b]shinies for every single one![/b]
[/p][p][b]🎮 Gameplay Changes[/b][/p][p]🎮 Core Unlocks: Every Rank Up grants you a new Core to make an Astral with, they are no longer available via normal rewards. This helps pace team growth with player progress.[/p][p]🎮 Complexity Progression: Various features are now unlocked at set Ranks rather than with win count. Makes the learning curve smoother and more predictable.[/p][p]🎮 A single Defence Stat: Previously we had a defence stat for both ranged and melee, but we've condensed this onto a single Defence stat as it seemed overly complex
🎮 Movement Refinement: Movement should now feel more responsive and polished. The code behind Movement has been adjusted and reworked multiple times over the past few months, it's tighter than before, and from what I've seen the jank is mostly gone! 
🎮 Rewards: Rewards have been split into more specific categories allowing for more challenge choices to encourage strategic planning and replayability.
[/p][p][b]🔧 Bug Fixes [/b]Ongoing polish and community feedback will help iron out the rest.[/p][p]🔧 There were a lot of bugs fixed over the past while, chances are if you had a bug before, its gone now. I'm sure there are new ones though, and we probably missed some :) Let me know! 
[/p][p][b]⚖️ Balance Changes[/b][/p][p]⚖️ Astral Stat Adjustments: All Astrals have been rebalanced from scratch. Each should now feel more distinct and viable.
⚖️ Skill Ranges: The max range has been reduced to help give melee a fighting chance.
⚖️ Skill Traits Frequency: The reward distribution has been adjusted to help teach the game better. Improves onboarding and player understanding of mechanics.
⚖️ Balance Adjustments: Numerous tweaks to improve overall gameplay flow. [/p]

notes.title: 🌟Astral Arena Alpha - v0.4🌟
notes.notes:
This update brings big changes to skills and combat: gone are the premade skills of old, in their place an exciting new SKILL CUSTOMISATION system allows you to add modules to skills, making them adaptive and varied! We've also added Engage & Disengage to how Astrals move in combat, which can be customised per skill! 
This and more !

Check out the full list below, and download for FREE over on [url=https://thegamegarden.itch.io/astral-arena-demo]itch![/url]

Change Log
🆕 New Features and Additions

🆕 The Skill Builder: Win modules to buff, boost and build your own custom skills! Adjust things like, Astral movement, multiple shots at once or in sequence, add buffs, debuffs and status effects, and there MAY be lasers! 

🆕 New Classic Roguelike Reward System: Rewards have been reworked to be more meaningful, choose from a selection of 3 rewards after each Challenger, and at the start of a new run you'll get to recover some lost items!


🎮 Gameplay Changes

🎮 Skill Unlocks: Skills are now progressed by upgrading them with modules you win from combat

🎮 Core Acquisition: Cores are now a reward type, meaning you can win them for free!

🎮 Challenger Rounds: Some challengers now require you to defeat them in multiple rounds without healing between fights! They offer more rewards in return!

🎮 The various shops are currently disabled, we plan on reintegrating them but for now they are at conflict with both the new skill builder system and the new rewards system

🎮 Balance Adjustments: Numerous tweaks to improve overall gameplay flow.



🔧 Bug Fixes

🔧 There were bugs with selecting enemy targets and player Astrals in 2v2+, now they are gone :)
🔧 The practice combat no longer causes fatal errors (Thankfully)
🔧 Various Fixes: Squashed several bugs to improve stability and game experience. Since we changed a lot of the game, many bugs simply are no longer relevant (Why fix a bug when you can just change the game? :) )

⚖️ Balance Changes

⚖️ The new Skills system has meant the enemies needed to learn to use the new skills, so we now have a procedural skill generator for the enemies to use, which scales with your progress
⚖️ Some Astrals have had their stats rebalanced
⚖️ Cores no longer scale with your wins, meaning early game Cores are more valuable than before
⚖️ Shiny odds reduced as they were very frequent

notes.title: 🌟Astral Arena Alpha - v0.0.3🌟
notes.notes:
[h1]Our Third Public Astral Arena Alpha Update is Here! [/h1]
This update brings big changes to deepen progression, refine gameplay, and add new strategic options. With 3 new types, expanded Astrals, and a fresh unlock system, there’s plenty to explore. We’ve also added NPCs like the Skill Master and Alchemist, who allow you to buy and upgrade skills and items, adding a new layer to your runs. Plus, with reworked Astral stats and persistent upgrades, every run is more rewarding and consistent.

Check out the full list below, and [url=https://thegamegarden.itch.io/astral-arena-demo]download for FREE![/url]

[h2]Change Log[/h2]
[h2]🆕 New Features and Additions[/h2]
🆕 Astralog: Introducing the Astralog, a comprehensive Dex that tracks each Astral you've encountered, including combat stats and player-specific stats like how many times you've defeated it.

🆕 Skill Master, Core Master, and Alchemist NPCs: New NPCs for skill and item purchases to deepen progression.

🆕 3 New Types: Acid, Water, and Fungus types have been added to expand strategic options.

🆕 Astrals Roster Expansion: Roster expanded from 6 to 13 Astrals (39 with all forms!).

🆕 New Unlock System: A fresh unlock system that rewards progress in a more structured way.

🆕 Persistent Save Data: We’re rogue-lite now, meaning progress and upgrades carry over between runs!

🆕 Credit Screen: Added a new credits screen to spotlight our team!

🆕 Type Chart: New type chart on the wall, which unlocks as you discover type interactions.

🆕 New Healing System: Added a healing statue in the prep area to heal between combats; upgrades increase healing capacity.

[h2]🎮 Gameplay Changes[/h2]
🎮 Self Skills: Self skills are back!

🎮 Skill Unlocks: Skills are now unlocked by purchasing them from the Skill Master, with a visible grade system to indicate skill quality.

🎮 Item Purchases: Items can now be purchased from the Alchemist.

🎮 Core Acquisition: Cores are now obtained by purchasing them from the Core Master.

🎮 Upgrades: Various aspects of the game can now be upgraded, with upgrades persisting between runs.

🎮 Updated Challengers: Now includes all types and type combinations, adding more variety!

🎮 Balance Adjustments: Numerous tweaks to improve overall gameplay flow.

🎮 Placeholder Models for New Astrals: Every Astral now has a model, even if placeholder.

🎮 Images for All Astrals: Each Astral has an image, including placeholders.

[h2]🔧 Bug Fixes[/h2]
🔧 Various Fixes: Squashed several bugs to improve stability and game experience. Since we changed a lot of the game, many bugs simply are no longer relevant (Why fix  a bug when you can just change the game? : ) )

[h2]⚖️ Balance Changes[/h2]
⚖️ Buffs/Debuffs: Buffs and debuffs now last longer to allow them to last long enough to be used.

⚖️ Enemy Scaling: Refactored and rebalanced enemy scaling to improve gameplay challenge and flow.

⚖️ Astral Stats: All Astrals have had their stats reworked and are no longer randomly generated, offering a more consistent and strategic experience.

notes.title: 🌟Astral Arena Alpha Demo - v0.2🌟
notes.notes:
[h1]Our second public Astral Arena Alpha update is now live! [/h1]

[b]Thanks to everyone who played the previous builds! Your feedback is what drives our development![/b]

We've mostly been working on improving the game progression systems so that the game has a better sense of advancement and to stop players getting overwhelmed by the amount of information the previous build would just toss at them from the get go - that no longer is the case! 

Additionally we've made a bunch of QoL improvements and bug fixes, added in save/load, as well as implementing the first stage of our own shiny system! The shinies themselves are all placeholder as they are just hue-shifted from the original colors, but we plan on being much more deliberate with them in future! 

[url=https://thegamegarden.itch.io/astral-arena-demo]You can download the update over on Itch[/url]

We're incredibly grateful for your ongoing feedback and support! Keep it coming—we’re listening! 🎧



[h1]Change Log[/h1]

[h2]🆕 New Features and Additions[/h2]
[list][*]🆕 New Save/Load System: Added the ability to continue a run later on.[/*]
[*]🆕 Status poster: Updated to unlock information as the player encounters it, reducing the potential for overwhelm at the start of the game.[/*]
[*]🆕 Main menu: New main menu & splash screen.[/*]
[*]🆕 Weather System: Introduced a new weather timer so players can plan around it better.[/*]
[*]🆕 Shinies: SHINIES NOW EXIST. The current system is a prototype; in the future, the shinies will be much more purposefully colored rather than simply hue-shifted from the originals.[/*]
[*]🆕 Crowd: The crowd actually exists now.[/*][/list]

[h2]🎮 Gameplay Changes[/h2]
[list][*]🎮 Self skills: Self skills no longer exist; they may make a comeback in the future.[/*]
[*]🎮 Buffs/Debuffs stack: Buffs/Debuffs now share a stack to reduce status icons; debuffs display negative stack numbers for clarity.[/*]
[*]🎮 Skill unlocks: Unlock skills over time rather than having them all at the start. This helps reduce the overwhelm players faced in the previous build.[/*]
[*]🎮 Enemy scaling: Refactored enemy scaling and rebalanced it to improve gameplay.[/*]
[*]🎮 Core frequency: Core frequency now based on wins.[/*]
[*]🎮 Performance: Enhanced performance. On the Steam Deck, maintaining combat FPS above 30 in most scenarios.[/*]
[*]🎮 Status effect poster: Moved the status effect poster to make it more noticeable.[/*]
[*]🎮 Keyboard controls: Adjusted default keyboard controls. Still a work in progress.[/*][/list]

[h2]🔧 Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list][*]🔧 Enemy stats: Enemy stats are now calculated correctly.[/*]
[*]🔧 Growth status effect: Fixed the growth status effect to display correct numbers.[/*]
[*]🔧 Cold skills: Cold skills now last longer, ensuring they can hit.[/*]
[*]🔧 Astrals healing: Astrals can no longer heal via growth if below 1% HP, preventing them from reviving after a fight.[/*]
[*]🔧 Skill equipping: Fixed skill equipping the wrong skill. This issue may still occur in some cases.[/*]
[*]🔧 Game reset: Fixed issue with the game not resetting correctly after a game over.[/*]
[*]🔧 Item & Skill descriptions: Fixed all descriptions.[/*]
[*]🔧 Status info: Fixed status info display.[/*]
[*]🔧 Player location: Fixed the bug where the game saved the player location, which could lead to escaping the world.[/*]
[*]🔧 Skill equipping cancellation: Fixed the issue where equipping a skill would proceed even if canceled.[/*]
[*]🔧 Elevator mechanics: Changes made to how the elevator works to fix a number of related bugs.[/*][/list]

[h2]⚖️ Balance Changes[/h2]
[list][*]⚖️ Core stats: New cores now use a different method for determining their stats.[/*]
[*]⚖️ Core distribution: Adjusted how cores are distributed to be more abundant early on and less abundant in the late game.[/*]
[*]⚖️ Skill rebalance: Rebalanced the skills & eliminated redundancy.[/*]
[*]⚖️ Item effects: Rebalanced item effects and effectiveness.[/*]
[*]⚖️ Difficulty curve: Rebalanced the difficulty curve.[/*]
[*]⚖️ Enemy scaling: Rebalanced enemy scaling.[/*]
[*]⚖️ Synergy: Synergy no longer reduces energy costs.[/*]
[*]⚖️ Goal wins: Reduced the goal wins from 30 down to 18, shortening the length of a run.[/*][/list]
